title: PII Redaction Vault
signature: class PiiVault: __init__(reidentify_roles), redact(tenant, text) -> str, reidentify(tenant, role, text) -> str, audit: list
hints: Run one pass per type in the fixed order EMAIL, CARD, SSN, PHONE, each with re.sub over the output of the previous pass. A CARD match that fails Luhn is put back unchanged.
Key the token table by (tenant, type, canonical value): lowercase emails, digits only for the rest, and drop the leading 1 of an 11-digit phone.
Check the role first. A denied attempt is an audit event too, appended before you raise.
